news.title: Consumer optimism slides to lowest since 2014 as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs
news.description: The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index tumbled to 81.9, a decline of 6.7 points and a reading well below the forecast for 89.

news.title: Property Play: Homeowners are sitting on record equity – and not using it
news.description: U.S. homeowners have more housing wealth than ever before, thanks to fast-rising home prices over the last several years. But they aren't spending much of it.
